title: 008我的妻子，轮不到你来管！
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

两人坐上电梯到了医院天台。

今天万里无云，但并不热，风轻轻拂过林萧的脸颊，竟让她在一瞬间恍惚，自己回到了那个充满阳光与热情的少女时代。

她看着潘廷旭，这人除了发型之外，其他什么地方都没变。

潘廷旭迈步向前数步，双手交叉枕在脑后，抬首凝望长空，看似闲散散心，余光却始终悄悄落在林萧身上。

两人都没默契地没有说话，大约三分钟后，潘廷旭才主动打破了沉默。

“好久没有仔细看这样好的蓝天了。”

林萧回过神，连忙回应，“我也很久没看了，之前心情不好，除了医院之外没去别的地方。”

午间的阳光洒在两人身上，让他们的身体变得暖洋洋。

潘廷旭打了个哈欠，侧头用闪着泪花的眸子看向林萧。

“其实我找你单独聊聊没什么事，我只是...只是觉得病房有点冷，想出来晒晒却又不想一个人。”

林萧点头，走到潘廷旭右侧，学着他的样子抬起头看向蓝天，“也好，这些年你在国外怎么样？”

“谈不上好坏，各有得失。”潘廷旭放下交叠的手臂，指尖轻点几下手机屏幕，转头看向林萧，“待会陪我吃顿午饭。”

林萧错愕挑眉，下意识想要婉拒，话音未出口便被他抢先截断。

“上次我送你到医院，你欠我一份人情，一顿饭刚好两清。”

人情在前，林萧再找不到推脱的由头，只能答应。

和潘廷旭在病房内安顿完母亲的午餐之后，两人一起去了那家餐厅。

这是一家火了三年多的传统日料店，预定餐位之后由厨师当面现做菜品。

但规矩繁多，厨师做什么你就得吃什么，没有选菜的余地，就算是厨师做得不好，不合口味，你也不能当面提意见，否则就会被拉入黑名单，终身不接待。

对于这样的餐厅，林萧一直都嗤之以鼻。

她认为花钱的一方就是对的，你做得不好，我还不能说你了？

潘廷旭和林萧坐在小包间里，旁边的有个小型操作台，厨师正在为他们烤制烧鸟。

“其实一直挺想问你，以后有什么打算，要继续在家里待着？”潘廷旭问。

林萧的目光落在他的手腕处，在看到那道淡粉色的伤疤时，顿时心中酸涩，她别过头，声音淡淡。

“实不相瞒，我最近去星野面试了，第一轮已经过了，下周一要考试。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The two took the elevator to the rooftop of the hospital.

It was cloudless today, but not hot. The wind gently brushed Lin Xiao's cheek, making her feel in a trance for a moment, and she returned to the girlhood full of sunshine and enthusiasm.

She looked at Pan Tingxu. Except for his hairstyle, nothing else had changed.

Pan Tingxu took a few steps forward, folded his hands behind his head, raised his head and stared at the sky, seemingly relaxed, but his peripheral vision always quietly fell on Lin Xiao.

The two of them remained silent without a tacit understanding. About three minutes later, Pan Tingxu took the initiative to break the silence.

"It's been a long time since I took a close look at such a beautiful blue sky."

Lin Xiao came to his senses and responded quickly, "I haven't seen it for a long time. I was in a bad mood before and I didn't go anywhere else except the hospital."

The midday sun shone on the two of them, making their bodies warm.

Pan Tingxu yawned and turned his head to look at Lin Xiao with tear-filled eyes.

"Actually, it's okay for me to talk to you alone. I just... just feel that the ward is a bit cold, and I want to go out and bask in the sun, but I don't want to be alone."

Lin Xiao nodded, walked to Pan Tingxu's right side, followed his example and raised his head to look at the blue sky, "That's fine, how have you been abroad these years?"

"It's not good or bad, everyone has his own gains and losses." Pan Tingxu put down his folded arms, tapped the screen of his phone a few times with his fingertips, and turned to look at Lin Xiao, "Have lunch with me later."

Lin Xiao raised his eyebrows in surprise and subconsciously wanted to decline, but he cut off his words before they came out.

"Last time I sent you to the hospital, you owed me a favor. A meal was enough to pay for it."

Favor came first, and Lin Xiao could no longer find any reason to shirk, so he could only agree.

After setting up mother's lunch with Pan Tingxu in the ward, the two went to the restaurant together.

This is a traditional Japanese restaurant that has been popular for more than three years. After booking a table, the chef will prepare the dishes in front of you.

But there are many rules. You have to eat whatever the chef cooks. There is no room to choose the dishes. Even if the chef does not do well and does not suit your taste, you cannot give your opinion in person, otherwise you will be blacklisted and will not be entertained for life.

Lin Xiao has always scorned such restaurants.

She believes that the one who spends money is right. If you don't do well, I can't criticize you?

Pan Tingxu and Lin Xiao were sitting in a small private room. There was a small operating table next to them, and the chef was grilling the roasted bird for them.

"Actually, I've always wanted to ask you, what are your plans in the future, do you want to continue to stay at home?" Pan Tingxu asked.

Lin Xiao's eyes fell on his wrist. When she saw the light pink scar, her heart suddenly felt sour. She turned her head away and spoke calmly.

"To be honest, I recently went to Hoshino for an interview. I have passed the first round and will take the exam next Monday."
